data.title: Donald Trump declares victory in Iran, but the Strait of Hormuz tells another story | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: This was another case of what has come to be known as TACO, Trump Chickens Out Again. This is not the first – and likely not the last – time he warns of strikes only to back down at the last minute.
data.keywords: Iran,Persian Gulf,Middle East,Donald Trump,strait of hormuz,America
